MANUFACTURING

From design to production, one team by your side.

A manufacturing partner for companies and research teams developing products. We help choose methods suited to each product’s purpose and quantity, connecting the work needed from physical testing to launch preparation.

Visit website

How we work together

The product’s purpose guides how it is made.

We begin with how the product will be used and its stage of development. Working through manufacturing choices together helps customers focus on their product and bringing it to market.

Core services

Design and manufacturing for each stage of development.

Product design

Develop the product’s form and structure from sketches and physical references, then prepare the design for manufacturing.

Prototyping

Use 3D printing and CNC machining to create physical parts for assessing design, assembly and function.

Small batches and production

Choose processes for the quantity required, with tooling, molding, finishing and assembly supporting production.

What would you like to make?

Tell us about the intended use, development stage and quantity. We can explore how to make your product together.
